verdict.rationale: Slack documents several official SDKs and frameworks. These include the Node Slack SDK covering 200+ Web API methods, Bolt for Java on the JVM, Bolt for Python and JavaScript via the CLI quickstart, and the Deno Slack SDK for TypeScript Slack-hosted workflows. All are hosted under the official docs.slack.dev/tools tree. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that building with these SDKs works well in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Send data to or query data from Slack using any of more than 200 methods.
Bolt for Java is a framework on the JVM that offers an abstraction layer to build Slack apps using modern platform features.
This quickstart guide covers how to create a Slack app using the Slack CLI and the Bolt frameworks, in either Python or JavaScript.
You can create Slack-hosted workflows written in TypeScript using the Deno Slack SDK.
